description: Chosen common Send/Board wording. Lookup errors are recoverable display state, never journaled payment evidence.

copy.notFound: Not yet seen by the network. This chain source does not currently know the transaction. Do not submit it again.
copy.lookupError: Couldn't check network status. Showing the last known network status. Try again.
copy.insufficientFunds: There are not enough confirmed onchain funds for this amount and its fees. Reduce the amount or wait for confirmation.
copy.belowMinimum: The amount Ark receives is below its minimum. Increase the boarding amount.
copy.reservedInputs: These coins are unavailable or reserved by another payment in review. Close that review, then try again.
copy.tooManyInputs: There are too many small coins for this board. Try a smaller amount.
copy.notSynced: Sync the wallet once before preparing a board.
copy.boardNotAttempted: Boarding was not submitted. Review again when the wallet is ready.
copy.broadcastFailed: Boarding submitted but unconfirmed. Noah will keep trying the broadcast. Do not board these funds again.
copy.broadcastPending: Submitted, awaiting broadcast. Noah will keep retrying the broadcast. Do not send this payment again.
copy.submitted: Submitted. Refresh to check network status. Do not send this payment again.
copy.uncertain: Noah has not confirmed the final outcome. Do not pay again. Checking status will never submit another payment.
